# ToTheWebPro - Full Documentation & AI Context

## Overview
ToTheWebPro (https://tothewebpro.com) is a modern web platform providing free online tools for webmasters, digital marketers, SEO specialists, copywriters, and software developers.

## Key Tool Details & Algorithms

### 1. Meta Title & Description Checker
- URL: https://tothewebpro.com/tools/meta-title-description-checker
- Features: 
  - Simulates Google SERP titles up to ~600px width.
  - Simulates Google SERP meta descriptions up to ~960px width.
  - Detects Open Graph (og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:type) and Twitter Cards (twitter:card, twitter:title).
  - Evaluates Canonical links and Robots directives.

### 2. Word & Character Counter
- URL: https://tothewebpro.com/tools/word-counter
- Features:
  - Real-time word count using regex word boundary matching.
  - Character counts with and without whitespace.
  - Estimated reading time (based on average 200 words per minute).
  - Estimated speaking time (based on average 130 words per minute).

### 3. Image Processing Tools (Compressor, Resizer, Converter, Background Remover)
- Compressor: https://tothewebpro.com/tools/image-compressor
- Resizer: https://tothewebpro.com/tools/image-resizer
- Converter: https://tothewebpro.com/tools/image-converter
- Features:
  - Executes locally in the user's browser using HTML5 Canvas and WebAssembly.
  - Supports WEBP, PNG, JPEG, and AVIF output formats.
  - Zero server storage; guarantees user data privacy.

### 4. Technical Architecture
- Framework: Next.js 14 (App Router)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Performance: 100/100 Google Lighthouse optimized, zero external heavy dependencies.
- Hosting & Edge CDN: Global Vercel Edge Network.
